title: Delete your account · Pekko
html:
Delete your Pekko account

Only the account owner can delete an account. You don't need the mobile app.

  1. Sign in with your account email and password. Forgot it? Reset your password by email first.
  2. You land on Delete account (also under Settings).
  3. Type DELETE, enter your password again, and confirm.
  4. Deletion runs 7 days later. Until then you can cancel from the same page.

What is deleted

Account and sign-in (email, password hash, display name)Deleted
Business name, locations, screens and screen tokensDeleted
Uploaded images and videos, menu boards, brand settingsDeleted (files removed from storage)
Playlists, schedules, promotions, screen groupsDeleted
Alerts, analytics, activity and plan-milestone recordsDeleted
Mobile app push notification tokensDeleted
Plan and trial statusDeleted

What is kept, and for how long

Deletion record (account id, user id, request and completion dates; no email or content)Kept as the record that the request finished. This application does not set a destruction date for that row.
Database and storage backups held by SupabaseDeleted data can remain in a backup until Supabase's own backup cycle drops it. This application does not set that cycle.
Payment records held by Stripe, if a paid subscription was startedPekko does not store card numbers. Stripe keeps its own billing records. This application does not set Stripe's retention period, and this page does not enable charges.
Server logs and pairing rate limitsError logs written by this app record the method, path, and a short message, not headers, cookies, or bodies. Pairing limits use the IP address as the limit key. Provider log retention is not set here.

Paired TVs stop playing and go back to the pairing screen. Ending a trial or plan never deletes anything; only this request does.
